description: VERSUS: create a head-to-head duel on a cabinet. Stakes exactly 0.25 USDC into the match escrow (same hard cap as a coin) and starts YOUR run immediately. A rival must join within 10 minutes or you are refunded in full. Winner gets their stake back + 25 QTR; loser's stake goes to the treasury; draw refunds both and pays both 25 QTR. Your match session becomes this server's active session.
name: coinop_create_match
